summary: You decide where your data lives, and guard alerts link straight to where you act.

new.title: You choose the Azure region
new.text: PIM Manager can now be installed in any Azure region. Before anything is created, setup checks every needed service is available there and suggests the nearest region if not.

new.title: Guard reports link to where you act
new.text: Each guard report now links to the page where you act on it: Approvals for a held change set, otherwise that guard's page.

new.title: Support sees where your environment lives
new.text: With an install key, the status report now names your environment's public addresses, so Invardia support can reach the right pages faster.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Active Directory DNS records are printed for you instead of written, and closing PIM Manager during setup works more reliably.
